prior_exploration: Existing source, route and ingredient analyses known. Joint source-by-policy robustness table not previously computed. Local prospective specification, not external preregistration.
question: Which documentary product–tariff candidates retain package support across all three route policies and alternative classification paths, and which depend on one path or policy?
unit: Swiss authorization and exact frozen tariff record; documentary direct SAI and authorization-linked SL paths only
ablation_scope: Remove classification path type; retain SAI authorization bridge required by SL. This is not withdrawal of all SAI records.
aggregation: VERIFIED if any SL package VERIFIED; CONTRADICTED only if at least one SL package and all SL packages CONTRADICTED; otherwise UNDETERMINED. Direct SAI carries no package route.
strong_robustness: Both classification path types support the exact pair, all three policies aggregate VERIFIED, and no SL path is CONTRADICTED under any policy. Completeness of route information is reported separately.
comparators: independent CSV/SQLite source reconstruction versus retained physical Neo4j witnesses; full package policy decisions bound to independently checked V23 digests
external_checks: WHO alteration relations for all SL-only recovered candidates; full formulation-section census of EMA Vfend document for voriconazole interpretation, without Swiss-authorization or tariff-eligibility promotion
